# MySQL
> MySQL provides the MySQL database, HeatWave cloud services, enterprise editions, downloads, documentation, training, and developer resources.

MySQL.com is the primary site for MySQL product information, commercial offerings, services, and support, while dev.mysql.com hosts official documentation, downloads, and developer resources for MySQL Server and related tools.

## Products
- [MySQL Products](https://www.mysql.com/products/): Overview of MySQL database products, editions, and deployment options.
- [MySQL HeatWave](https://www.mysql.com/products/heatwave/): Managed MySQL cloud service with analytics, machine learning, and AI capabilities.
- [MySQL Enterprise Edition](https://www.mysql.com/products/enterprise/): Commercial edition with security, backup, monitoring, and support features.
- [MySQL Standard Edition](https://www.mysql.com/products/standard/): Subscription edition for production deployments with support and management tools.
- [MySQL Classic Edition](https://www.mysql.com/products/classic/): Entry commercial edition for OEMs, ISVs, and production database deployments.
- [MySQL Cluster CGE](https://www.mysql.com/products/cluster/): Carrier-grade clustered database for high availability and telecom-scale workloads.
- [MySQL Embedded (OEM/ISV)](https://www.mysql.com/oem/): Embedded and redistribution licensing for software vendors and device makers.

## Documentation
- [MySQL Documentation](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/): Central documentation portal for MySQL Server, tools, connectors, and reference manuals.
- [MySQL 8.4 Reference Manual](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/): Official reference for MySQL 8.4 features, SQL, administration, and configuration.
- [MySQL 8.0 Reference Manual](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/): Comprehensive manual for MySQL 8.0 server usage, SQL syntax, and operations.
- [MySQL Shell Manual](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/mysql-shell/8.0/en/): Documentation for MySQL Shell scripting, administration, and DevAPI usage.
- [MySQL Router Manual](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/mysql-router/8.0/en/): Reference for configuring MySQL Router for high availability and routing.
- [MySQL Workbench Manual](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/workbench/en/): Official guide to modeling, SQL development, administration, and migration in Workbench.
- [MySQL NDB Cluster Documentation](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/mysql-cluster.html): Documentation for MySQL NDB Cluster architecture, setup, and administration.

## Downloads
- [MySQL Downloads](https://www.mysql.com/downloads/): Main downloads page for MySQL server, tools, and related products.
- [MySQL Community Server](https://dev.mysql.com/downloads/mysql/): Download MySQL Community Server binaries and installers for supported platforms.
- [MySQL NDB Cluster](https://dev.mysql.com/downloads/cluster/): Download MySQL NDB Cluster packages for distributed, highly available deployments.
- [MySQL Shell](https://dev.mysql.com/downloads/shell/): Download MySQL Shell for administration, scripting, and DevAPI development.
- [MySQL Router](https://dev.mysql.com/downloads/router/): Download MySQL Router for application routing and high availability setups.
- [MySQL Workbench](https://dev.mysql.com/downloads/workbench/): Download MySQL Workbench for database design, querying, and administration.
- [MySQL Installer for Windows](https://dev.mysql.com/downloads/installer/): Windows installer for MySQL server, clients, and development tools.

## Developer Resources
- [Developer Zone](https://dev.mysql.com/): Entry point for MySQL developers, documentation, downloads, and technical resources.
- [MySQL Server Doxygen](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/index-other.html): Additional technical documentation indexes and generated reference resources.
- [MySQL Tutorial](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/tutorial.html): Introductory tutorial covering basic SQL and MySQL database operations.
- [MySQL Reference Manuals](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/): Core server documentation for SQL, replication, security, and administration.
- [MySQL Example Databases](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/index-other.html): Access sample schemas and supplementary developer materials.
- [MySQL Connectors Documentation](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/index-connectors.html): Documentation index for official MySQL connectors and client libraries.

## Training and Certification
- [MySQL Training](https://www.mysql.com/training/): Official training courses for developers, DBAs, and architects using MySQL.
- [MySQL Certification](https://www.mysql.com/certification/): Certification program information for validating MySQL administration and development skills.
- [MySQL Learning Subscription](https://www.mysql.com/training/subscription/): Subscription-based access to MySQL training content and learning resources.
- [MySQL Training on Demand](https://www.mysql.com/training/on-demand.html): Self-paced MySQL training options for flexible online learning.
- [MySQL Public Training](https://www.mysql.com/training/schedule.html): Scheduled instructor-led MySQL training classes and course calendar.

## Support and Services
- [MySQL Support](https://www.mysql.com/support/): Support offerings, knowledge resources, and service options for MySQL customers.
- [MySQL Services](https://www.mysql.com/services/): Consulting, implementation, migration, and advisory services from MySQL experts.
- [Contact MySQL](https://www.mysql.com/about/contact/): Contact information for sales, support, and general MySQL inquiries.
- [Worldwide Contact Numbers](https://www.mysql.com/about/contact/phone/): Regional phone numbers and country-specific contact information.
- [MySQL Enterprise Edition](https://www.mysql.com/products/enterprise/): Commercial subscription with enterprise support and advanced operational features.

## HeatWave and Cloud
- [MySQL HeatWave](https://www.mysql.com/products/heatwave/): Cloud-native MySQL service for transactions, analytics, machine learning, and AI.
- [MySQL HeatWave on AWS](https://www.mysql.com/cloud/): Managed MySQL HeatWave deployment information for cloud environments.
- [MySQL HeatWave Documentation](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/heatwave/en/): Documentation for using HeatWave features and service capabilities.
- [MySQL Autopilot](https://www.mysql.com/products/heatwave/): Information on automated performance and management capabilities in HeatWave.

## Community and Events
- [MySQL Developer Zone](https://dev.mysql.com/): Community-facing developer hub for technical resources and product information.
- [Free Webinars](https://www.mysql.com/news-and-events/web-seminars/): Upcoming and on-demand MySQL webinars on products and technical topics.
- [White Papers](https://www.mysql.com/why-mysql/white-papers/): Technical and business white papers about MySQL products and use cases.
- [MySQL News and Events](https://www.mysql.com/news-and-events/): Announcements, webinars, and event-related MySQL updates.
- [MySQL Blogs](https://blogs.oracle.com/mysql/): Official Oracle MySQL blog with product updates and technical articles.

## Account and Access
- [Login](https://www.mysql.com/auth/login/?dest=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mysql.com%2F): Sign in to MySQL web properties and account-enabled services.
- [Register](https://www.mysql.com/auth/register/): Create a MySQL web account for downloads and service access.
- [Oracle Copyright Notice](https://www.oracle.com/legal/copyright.html): Legal copyright information for Oracle-owned MySQL web content.
